merits-summary: Trailing comments handled with the correct YAML rule (a # only starts a comment after whitespace — verified at stripFrontmatterComment, cardstatus.go:118-128). Quoted # preserved, with unterminated/mismatched quotes left intact rather than guessed. Repeated keys rejected as an error rather than first-wins or last-wins, matching strict YAML. Error propagation checked at all four call sites. The card's stated scope discipline ('this is deliberately not a YAML parser') is honoured by the implementation.
